Atomic Issue create with blocker edges (#136)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-38
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    - Persist CreateIssue blocker declarations in one PostgreSQL create transaction under the Workspace topology lock.
    - Emit a single issue.created event with the exact declaration and IDs; keep initial Issue version at 1 without blocker-added events.
    - Cover rollback, replay, cross-workspace/repo validation, archived/non-Task rejection, and create/topology-lock concurrency.
    
    ## Test plan
    - [x] cargo test -p codeon-postgres --features postgres-acceptance --test issue_blockers create_with_blockers
    - [x] cargo test -p codeon-postgres --features postgres-acceptance --test issue_core agent_routing
    - [x] cargo clippy -p codeon-postgres --features postgres-acceptance --all-targets -- -D warnings
    - [x] cargo fmt --all --check
